create.name: Lisa Williams
create.bio:
Lisa Williams is an English-born psychic medium and teacher of mediumship who has worked with spirit communication for more than thirty years. She grew up with the practice in the family, as her grandmother was also a medium, and her readings later took her to Los Angeles, where a meeting with the producer Merv Griffin led to her first television series, Lisa Williams: Life Among the Dead, one of three shows built around her work. She has since written books on the afterlife and channelled guidance, published oracle and affirmation decks, and spoken to large audiences in many countries.

Much of her teaching now runs through The Psychic Medium Training Academy, her online school, which offers self-paced courses for beginners, short live series on topics such as intuition and blending with spirit, and longer certification tracks for spiritual advisers and future teachers; she says thousands of students have trained with her, among them more than forty certified Master Teachers. She also gives private readings and coaching, hosts a weekly podcast and YouTube channel with conversations and guided meditations on intuition, signs from loved ones and soul purpose, and leads occasional pilgrimages, including a walk on Japan's Kumano Kodo in 2027. She runs her business from Southern California.

books.title: Divine Wisdom: Messages of Love, Hope and Healing from the Masters
books.author: Lisa Williams
books.description: Short channelled passages meant to be opened at random and read slowly after a few counted breaths. Williams presents them as messages from the Masters, offered as daily reflection or read straight through.

courses.title: The Beginner's Guide to Psychic Mediumship
courses.description: A self-paced foundation course on working with spirit and energy. It sets out how a psychic connection differs from a mediumistic one and gives exercises for building each.

courses.title: Blending with Spirit
courses.description: An on-demand workshop on how a medium merges their awareness with a communicator in spirit, built around five keys for steadier and fuller readings.

courses.title: Enhance Your Intuition
courses.description: A recorded programme for people who notice intuitive nudges but are unsure what to do with them. Williams shows ways to recognise, test and act on that inner guidance.

courses.title: Mastering Your Intuition
courses.description: A five-part video series on opening and widening intuitive ability and bringing it into daily decisions, work and relationships.

courses.title: Awaken your Inner Wisdom in 21 days
courses.description: The recordings of a three-week intuition challenge, with daily sessions, workbooks and weekly meditations. It also introduces oracle cards, crystals and the pendulum as tools.

courses.title: Walking Between Worlds: Spirit of Japan
courses.description: A twelve-day small-group pilgrimage in Japan, organised with Sacred Earth Journeys, that includes walking sections of the Kumano Kodo trail with time for reflection and spirit connection along the way. Price per person from the twin rate; single rooms cost more.
